description: 한국에너지기술연구원_풍력 시공간 자원정보 서비스 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국에너지기술연구원. 한국에너지기술연구원에서 제공하는 풍력 시공간 자원정보 서비스는 대한민국 전역의 위경도 좌표를 기반으로 구축된 고해상도 풍력 자원 데이터입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국에너지기술연구원. Its tags are 풍력, 시공간, 자원정보, 좌표기반, 에너지. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
